documents.population: Undergraduate international applicants (FAQ of the Academic Services Department)
documents.notes: Universiti Malaya Academic Services Department, 'FAQ Undergraduate International Admission' (page footer 'Last Update: 02/12/2021'; it remains the official FAQ on 2026-10-19). Documents must be certified by the school principal, government officers, a Commissioner of Oath or the embassy. Applicants without an English certificate may apply but must provide one within the stipulated deadline if accepted. Not drafted: the RM300 processing fee.

items.quote: All applications must be submitted online via e-application.
Recent passport-size photographs with a blue background
Certified copies of passport (first page only - photo, owner details and validity)
Certified copies of academic certificate with detailed academic transcripts/results for Higher School Certificate (HSC)
detailed academic transcripts/results for Higher School Certificate (HSC) , Grade 12 or GCE (A' Level) or Diploma from recognized Institutions.
Official translation is needed for applicants whose native language is not English or Malay
items.condition: native language is not English or Malay

items.quote: Certified copies of TOEFL/IELTS or other equivalent examinations indicating English proficiency (if available)
items.condition: if available at application; accepted applicants without one must provide it within the stipulated deadline

items.quote: A letter of guarantee from the sponsor for sponsored students
